# Labels

| Label | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `good first issue` | Small, well-scoped, with a pointer to the files involved |
| `help wanted` | Maintainers would welcome a contribution |
| `new-check` | A new rule in select-verify or a new delivery contract |
| `new-pack` | A business pack (contracts, prompts, demo data for a trade) |
| `autonomy` | Trust engine, licences, sampling, risk caps |
| `ui` | Interface, design system, accessibility |
| `security` | Anything that could weaken isolation, secrets or approvals |
| `bug` | Behaviour differs from the documentation |
| `docs` | Documentation only |
